انتويتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَوَيْتُنَّ (intawaytunna) /in.ta.waj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَوَى (intawā)
# اُنْتُوِيتُنَّ (untuwītunna) /un.tu.wiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَوَى (intawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
